'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[Arab–Israeli conflict]]
***[[Gaza war|Israel–Hamas war]]
****[[Siege of Gaza City]]
*****[[Attacks on health facilities during the Gaza war#Al-Shifa ambulance airstrike|Al-Shifa ambulance airstrike]]
******Fifteen people are killed and 60 others are injured by an [[Israeli Air Force|Israeli]] [[airstrike]] against a convoy of [[ambulance]]s en route from [[al-Shifa Hospital]] in the [[Gaza Strip]] to [[Rafah, Egypt|Rafah]], [[Egypt]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/11/3/several-killled-in-israeli-attack-on-ambulance-convoy-gaza-health-ministry (Al Jazeera)]
*****At least 14 people are killed by an [[Israel]]i airstrike against [[civilian]]s fleeing to southern Gaza. [https://www.barrons.com/news/hamas-ministry-says-israeli-strike-kills-14-people-fleeing-to-south-gaza-5403b1b4 (AFP via ''Barron's'')]
****[[Blockade of the Gaza Strip]]
*****Twelve [[cancer]] patients have died in the Gaza Strip after the [[Turkish-Palestinian Friendship Hospital]], Gaza's only medical facility serving cancer patients, was forced to suspend operations after running out of fuel. [https://www.dawn.com/news/1786107/a-dozen-cancer-patients-died-since-hospital-shut-down-gaza-ministry (Dawn)]
**[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
***At a Hezbollah rally in Beirut, [[Hezbollah]] [[Secretary-General of Hezbollah|Secretary-General]] [[Hassan Nasrallah]] gives a widely awaited first speech since the start of the [[Gaza war]] to supporters. Nasrallah claims that the presence of [[United States Navy|U.S. warships]] in the [[Mediterranean Sea]]; "doesn't scare us". [https://apnews.com/article/hassan-nasrallah-hezbollah-hamas-israel-cf7d6969db43e5d902580546ac4e4c22 (APNews)]
*[[Insurgency in Balochistan]]
**[[2023 Gwadar ambush]]
***Fourteen [[Pakistan Army|soldiers]] are killed in an [[ambush]] against their convoy in [[Gwadar District]], [[Balochistan, Pakistan|Balochistan]], Pakistan. [https://www.voanews.com/a/insurgents-kill-14-soldiers-in-southwestern-pakistan/7340645.html (VOA)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**[[2023 Dera Ismail Khan bombing]]
***Five people are killed and 20 others are injured by a [[Car bomb|motorcycle bomb]] at a bus stop in [[Dera Ismail Khan]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]], [[detonate]]d as a [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Police|police]] bus carrying officers passed by. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-bomb-police-bus-taliban-5d7f0ec03d9620ab4845c10704de1b8a (AP)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Southern front of the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Southern Ukraine campaign]]
***A [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[missile]] strike kills more than 20 [[Ukrainian Ground Forces|Ukrainian soldiers]] at an awards ceremony near the [[front line]] in [[Zaporizhzhia Oblast]]. [[President of Ukraine|President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] says the incident "could have been avoided" amid anger over the losses. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-67327411 (BBC News)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*The [[University of Edinburgh]] in [[Scotland]], [[United Kingdom]], returns the remains of four [[Paiwan people|Paiwan]] warriors to the [[Taiwanese indigenous peoples|Taiwanese indigenous community]], marking the first international [[Repatriation (cultural property)|repatriation]] of ancestral remains for [[Taiwan]]. The skulls, which the university acquired in 1907 and are believed to have been [[Japanese invasion of Taiwan (1874)|taken by Japanese forces]] in 1874, will be housed at the [[National Museum of Prehistory (Taiwan)|National Museum of Prehistory]] in [[Taitung City|Taitung]] while awaiting a final resting place decision from [[Mudan, Pingtung|Mudan]] authorities. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/uk-university-returns-tribal-warrior-skulls-to-taiwan (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Nepal earthquake]]
**A magnitude 5.6 [[earthquake]] strikes [[Karnali Province]], [[Nepal]], killing at least 157 people and injuring over 300 more. Several houses are destroyed. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/rescuers-struggle-find-nepal-quake-survivors-deaths-137-2023-11-04/ (Reuters)]
*[[Langarud drug rehabilitation center fire]]
**A fire at a [[drug rehabilitation]] center in [[Langarud]], [[Gilan province|Gilan]], [[Iran]], kills 32 people and injures 16. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/nov/03/dozens-killed-in-blaze-at-drug-rehab-centre-in-iran (AFP via ''The Guardian'')]
*An [[airplane]] flying from [[Zagreb]], [[Croatia]], [[plane crash|crashes]] as it approaches [[Salzburg]], [[Austria]], killing four people. [https://apnews.com/article/austria-plane-crash-croatia-salzburg-1bcdc78f3e7edc573ac8ceaeadaa5653 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[International reactions to the Gaza war|International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Honduras]] recalls its [[ambassador]] to [[Israel]] in response to Israel's [[Gaza war|military actions]] in the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://news.yahoo.com/honduras-recalls-ambassador-israel-consultations-202226076.html (Reuters via Yahoo! News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Gaza war protests|Israel–Hamas war protests]]
**Protesters gather in [[Amman]], [[Jordan]], to urge [[King of Jordan|King]] [[Abdullah II of Jordan|Abdullah II]] to advocate for a [[ceasefire]] in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. [https://www.barrons.com/news/thousands-rally-in-jordan-capital-for-gaza-ceasefire-eab54786 (AFP via ''Barron's'')]
*[[2023 New Zealand general election]]
**The [[Electoral Commission (New Zealand)|Electoral Commission]] concludes vote counting, which shows that the leading [[New Zealand National Party|National Party]] requires [[Coalition government|a coalition]] with the [[ACT New Zealand|ACT]] and [[New Zealand First]] [[List of political parties in New Zealand|parties]] to form [[New Zealand Government|a government]] after the final tally reveals a shift in [[New Zealand Parliament|parliamentary]] seats. [https://apnews.com/article/new-zealand-election-christopher-luxon-final-count-dec8fc183a3e814515fca6eaef7c2d8c (AP)]

'''Science and technology'''
*An eruption takes place off the coast of [[Iwo Jima]], forming a temporary new island and continuing the first magmatic eruptions of the volcano in at least 1000 years. [https://www.asahi.com/ajw/articles/15048458 (asahi.com)]
